source_time_scope: Provider labels a daily average; source has no time_bnds. Exact averaging support is not invented.

comparison.scope: Same labelled date, different products and methods, shared satellite inputs possible; not independent observational validation or an uncertainty interval.

interpretation: Finite OSW contour scan inspired by maximum-velocity front methods; original supplemental implementation and gates not reproduced. Scanned levels do not form a physical uncertainty or width range.
